These synthetic fixtures contain only the fictional name Jordan Sample and generic experience text.

`resume.pdf`, `resume.docx`, `resume.md`, and `resume.txt` exercise supported text extraction. `encrypted.pdf` uses PDF Standard Security revision 2 with the test-only password `secret`. `scanned.pdf` is a textless page that exercises the no-readable-text path; the application does not perform OCR.

The PDF fixtures were assembled from minimal PDF objects, and the DOCX fixture is a minimal ZIP of WordprocessingML files. No personal resumes or third-party documents are included.
